RAJYA  SABHA

List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the April 21, 2008/V aisakha  1, 1930  (Saka)

(Ministries: Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Law
and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Power;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Women and Child
Development)
Total number of questions  20
121
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Cost for generation of solar energy
*381. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE
ENERGY be pleased to state:
(a) the cost per MW for generation of
solar energy; and
(b) the steps Government is taking to
make solar energy more cost effective?
Power stations
*382. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARW AL: W ill the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of power stations/
sub-stations in the States, including Delhi;
(b) the extent to which the capacity of
power generation has increased during the
last three years, year-wise and power
station-wise;
(c) whether Government proposes to
increase the power generation capacity of
these power stations; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Permanent benches of High Court in
Orissa
*383. SHRI BHAGIRATHI MAJHI:
Will the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has given any
direction to the Orissa Government on
establishment of permanent benches of
High Court as per the recommendation of
Jaswant Singh Commission constituted by
the Central Government;
(b) if so, at which places these benches
are being considered and by when; and
(c) whether, as per the merger agreement
of Mayurbhanj with Orissa and Central
Government, one of such bench is being
planned at Baripada, the headquarter of
Mayurbhanj district?
Generation of renewable energy
*384. SHRI MAHMOOD A.
MADANI: Will the Minister of NEW
AND RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased
to state:
(a) what is the total generation of solar

122
energy and other renewable energy in the
country;
(b) the estimated plan for production
of renewable energy; and
(c) what steps Government is taking to
increase the capacity to the plan level?
Royalty on mineral exploration
*385. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRA-
IAH: Will the Minister of MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is proposing
any measures to review the royalty issue
pertaining to mineral exploration in the
country;
(b) if so, whether the said review would
provide additional revenues, to that of the
present, to the States where the exploration/
mining is taking place;
(c) if so, the details of the new
methodology that would be adopted to
calculate the royalty payable to the States;
and
(d) how much additional revenue is
expected to accrue to Andhra Pradesh
during 2008-09?
Rating of management institutions
*386. SHRIMATI SYEDA
ANW ARA TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
introduce rating for management
institutions, similar to international
standards such as ISO:9001, to encourage
their swift movement towards achieving
excellence; and
(b) if so, whether an independent
Regulatory Authority for Higher Education
would be constituted and entrusted with
taking a holistic view, so that standards of
our higher education, technical and
management, could be further improved,
to enable our students to compete
successfully in the growing global market?
Declining trend of academic research
*387. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country
is still lagging behind in the field of academic
research;
(b) whether it is also a fact that research
work in the country is negligible, in
comparison to America, England, France,
China, Japan and Germany; and
(c) if so, the total number of research
papers published by all the above countries
at the international level in 2005, 2006 and
2007?
Representation of non-teaching
 staff in universities
*388. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
demand of the All India University
Employees Confederation, to provide
representation to non-teaching employees
in the decision-making bodies of the
universities;
(b) if so, whether any steps have been
taken by Government;
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

123
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Sexual abuse at work place
*389. SHRI BRIJ BHUSHAN
TIWARI: Will the Minister of WOMEN
AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there has
been an increase in the incidents of sexual
abuse at the work places during the recent
past;
(b) if so, whether any step has been
taken by Government to check such
incidents; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Post-Matric scholarship for OBCs
*3
